imagePrompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image1, a registered 1100x846 UV texture crop for an existing 3D anime character head. It contains a tilted facial skin island and surrounding hair/accessory UV fragments. Image2 is only an identity/style reference. This is a UV asset edit, not a new portrait.
Preserve the exact crop aspect, island outlines, placement and orientation, original eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, glasses lines, nose, cheek color, hair, ornaments and all pixels outside the mouth area. Do not recenter, rotate, scale, redraw or rearrange any UV island. The existing mouth is the tiny brown curved mark centered approximately (405,555) in the 1100x846 crop, inside the facial skin. Match the TILTED face's mouth axis and orientation, not the horizontal canvas.
Replace ONLY that tiny mouth with a clearly readable warm, happy smiling mouth: lifted corners, a modest but visible opening, a narrow warm-white upper-tooth crescent and soft warm peach lower lip/interior. The expression should unmistakably read as smiling at 3D avatar viewing distance, instead of a tiny ambiguous comma. Target width about 75-95 pixels along the mouth's tilted local axis and height about 30-45 pixels, centered at exactly the existing mouth. Keep it within the mouth neighborhood x320..490,y490..620. Make a friendly gentle open-mouth smile; not a wide scream or exaggerated grin. Do not add lipstick, chin shadow, tongue sticking out, dimples, extra teeth or marks. Do not change the eyes: they remain the same original OPEN eyes from Image1. Face proportions, geometry, identity and all other features are fixed. Return the same registered UV crop layout.
## Art Style (MANDATORY for all nanatau generations)
- Proportions: 5.5-6 head ratio. NOT chibi, NOT tall-realistic. Compact-cute middle ground.
- Lineart: Clean, thin-to-medium weight lines with clear intent. Hair strands clearly separated with visible flow direction. NOT thick chunky outlines, NOT sketchy.
- Coloring: FLAT cel shading only. Warm color temperature throughout. Minimal shadows (soft single-layer if any). NO excessive gradients, NO AI-like glossy sheen, NO heavy rendering.
- Eyes: Large but proportionally natural. Round with multiple highlight layers. Detailed iris (gradient within, visible reflection layers). Expressive and emotional — the eyes carry the character's personality. Preserve the existing open eyes exactly in this edit.
- Expression preference: Introverted, fragile emotions — teary, sleepy, embarrassed, trying-her-best. "Quiet bravery in vulnerability." NOT genki/energetic, NOT cool/sharp.
- Composition: Character-centered, 1-2 poses per image (character sheet style works well). Props held close to body. For this technical edit preserve the input UV layout.
- Background: MINIMAL. Simple warm gradient (cream/pale yellow to white) or dark navy night sky with stars. Never complex or distracting. For this technical edit preserve every existing UV fragment.
- Color temperature: WARM throughout. Even dark backgrounds should feel warm due to the character's yellow palette.
- Overall feel: Soft, gentle, healing. The kind of illustration that makes you feel warm and want to protect this character. Existing accents Pale Butter Yellow #FFFDE7 / Soft Navy #2C3E6B / Warm White #FFF8E1.
